moex:PTZ6.usd_per_price_unit_basis: MOEX ISS description for this contract publishes UNIT=USD (quotation currency) and FACEUNIT=USD (settlement currency); the exchange-published tick value (STEPPRICE 8.43414 RUB per MINSTEP 0.1 = 84.3414 RUB/USD) converts to ~1 USD per 1.0 of price, so one lot is one underlying unit and 1.0 of price movement is exactly 1 USD per contract.

source.note: Official MOEX ISS quote. The exchange publishes a best bid/offer, last price, settlement price, traded volume and open interest - but no per-level depth, which is why MOEX fills are quote-based and size-capped by published volume.
